Chapter 6464: Unworthy

Chapter 6464: Unworthy

“Oceanic Azure Seal!” He roared and released a blue ocean encompassing all of Gold Village. It contained dao power, golden power, and a hint of the heaven’s supreme power.

Thus, Iron-spear’s domineering attack couldn’t contend, being pushed back continuously.

Iron-spear reverted to a defensive stance, pulling his spear back.

“Bam!” His grand dao still exploded upon contact. He vomited a mouthful of blood before smashing through numerous peaks.

His body looked like a cracked porcelain vase. However, he would survive as long as his primal anima was still around. He leaped into the air and tried to run out of Gold Village.

He realized staying in Gold Village was impossible while evading Ocean-gaze and Luosha. He entered one dimension after another during the escape.

“Devil Seal!” Luosha was ready for this and prepared a spatial stop. Countless jade walls appeared, seemingly rising from hell and blessed with its power.

Iron-spear slammed into one of the walls and jolted backward. His face became a bloody pulp.

Luosha had reached the second cycle with the help of the golden power. Iron-spear had no time to react before Ocean-gaze came with a mystical grasping technique.

Iron-spear utilized his dao but couldn’t break free. The two then took him back.

“Bam!” They threw him before Li Qiye.

“Young Noble, we have captured Iron-spear Ancestor. Please decide what to do with him.” They bowed and said.

The crowd stared at the bloodied Iron-spear in astonishment. How could such an unbeatable character be reduced to this state?

Earthsplitter and Rising saw those two addressing Li Qiye as “young noble” and became startled.

Luosha was weaker and couldn’t compare to them. However, Ocean-gaze was different since he was at the heaven level.

The two tried to come up with an identity deserving of this treatment from Ocean-gaze.

“You insist on choosing the hard way each time. How do you want to die now?” Li Qiye asked Iron-spear.

Iron-spear recalled the last time he was smashed with a pot. His head was smashed and he has been thinking about revenge by drinking the brat’s blood.

He didn’t have time to carry this out and today, he found himself in a more humiliating situation. His cultivation was sealed by the opponents, leaving him helpless.

“He’s finished. What about you two?” Li Qiye then leaned back on his chair and smiled at Rising and Earthsplitter.

Their complexion changed, aware of how dreadful he was. Unfortunately, they cared about their reputation and status in Old World. Running away without a fight was not their style.

“Amitabha, I would like to try.” Rising stepped forward.

“If you want to fight, I will kill you.” Earthsplitter took a deep breath and summoned a weapon for a direct attack.

Her weapon was a halberd seemingly made from golden laws, sharp enough to cut the village into two halves. It exceeded her cultivation and was the reason for her confidence.

Moreover, she preferred to die in battle rather than beg for forgiveness.

“My ancestor has no equal. You are unworthy.” A voice suddenly echoed across Golden Village.
